Name: The Return of Immersive Scarecrows (obsolete)
Author: lucaskfreitas
Description:
[size=5][b]This mod is obsolete, don't download this![/b][/size]
[size=4]Instead, check the newer mod done by the original author: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44338]Immersive Sprinklers and Scarecrows[/url][/size]


[size=5][b]Disclaimer[/b][/size]

This project is a Fork of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15290]Immersive Scarecrows[/url], a Stardew Valley mod originally from aedenthorn.

The purpose of this fork is basically to make it compatible with version 1.6 of SV, which was released on March 19, 2024.

[b][i]Warning: this mod is still at its early stages, so some bugs might still exist.[/i][/b]

If you like this mod and would like to make a donation to support it, you can do so at [url=https://ko-fi.com/lucaskfreitas]ko-fi[/url]﻿. I really appreciate support of any kind!


[size=4][b]Also check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20796/]The Return of Immersive Sprinklers[/url].﻿[/b][/size]


﻿[size=5][b]Overview[/b][/size]

With this mod you can place scarecrows directly onto tilled soil tiles. Scarecrows will be placed on the corner closest to the mouse cursor and protect crops surrounding it.

Immersive scarecrows can be passed through by the farmer.

To remove a scarecrow, hover over it and press the pickup key (default [b]E[/b]).

You can swap the scarecrow at any junction with another by placing it at the same junction.

You can check a scarecrow range by hovering over it and holding down the range check key (default [b]Left Alt[/b]).

You can change scarecrow scale, opacity, and position in the config.


[size=5][b]Notes[/b][/size]

Scarecrows are stored in the tilled soil object; the mod will prevent the destruction of the tilled soil containing the scarecrow.

Scarecrow radius will be affected by mods that change scarecrow radius or add scarecrow with custom radii. Modded scarecrows with different protection shapes or mechanics will not affect immersive scarecrows.


[size=5][b]Config[/b][/size]

You can customize this mod by editing the config file or using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url].

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/lucaskfreitas/ImmersiveScarecrows]https://github.com/lucaskfreitas/ImmersiveScarecrows[/url].
